blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Cells and Subcellular Organelles) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Cells perform all the fundamental activities of life. Explain how cells show movement, nutrition, respiration, excretion, homeostasis, growth and reproduction. (4 marks)
(Cells zindagi ke tamam bunyadi kaam karte hain. Wazahat karein ke cells movement, nutrition, respiration, excretion, homeostasis, growth aur reproduction kaise dikhate hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Movement: cells harkat karte hain; sperm cells flagella se chalte hain, white blood cells infection se larne ke liye khoon mein safar karte hain aur cell ke andar organelles bhi harkat karte hain.

Nutrition: cells mahol se ghiza lete hain taa ke energy banayen, apne dhaanche banayen aur biochemical reactions chalayen.

Respiration: cells glucose tor kar ATP banate hain jo cell ke kaamon ki energy currency hai.

Excretion: cells diffusion aur active transport se fuzla nikalte hain taa ke zehreele maadde jama na hon.

Homeostasis: cells membranes ke aar paar maaddon ki harkat control kar ke andar ka mahol mustahkam rakhte hain.

Growth: cells ghiza le kar use apne hisson mein badal kar barhte hain.

Reproduction: cells mitosis (growth aur marammat ke liye aik jaise daughter cells) aur meiosis (sexual reproduction ke gametes) se nasal barhate hain.

book_ref.quote: Cells perform all the fundamental activities that characterize living organisms

blocks.prompt:
2 Trace the history of the cell theory from Robert Hooke to Louis Pasteur. (i) Describe the observations of Hooke, Leeuwenhoek, Lamarck and Brown. (ii) Describe the contributions of Schleiden, Schwann, Virchow and Pasteur and state the three points of the cell theory. (4 marks)
(Robert Hooke se Louis Pasteur tak cell theory ki tareekh bayan karein. (i) Hooke, Leeuwenhoek, Lamarck aur Brown ke mushahidaat. (ii) Schleiden, Schwann, Virchow aur Pasteur ka hissa aur cell theory ke teen nukaat.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Ibtidai mushahidaat:
• 1665, Robert Hooke (English) ne oak darakht ke cork ka patla tukra, aur tanay aur jar ke tukre dekhe aur "many little boxes" paaye. Us ne kaha ke paudon ke hisse khaanon se bane hain aur unhein "cellulae" kaha.
• 1673, Anton van Leeuwenhoek (Dutch) ne behtar microscope bana kar talaab ke paani mein zinda cells dekhe aur unhein animalcules kaha.
• 1809, Jean Baptiste de-Lamarck (French) ne bhi janwaron aur paudon ke hisson mein cells dekhe.
• 1831, Robert Brown (British botanist) ne cell mein nucleus daryaft kiya.

(ii) Theory ka banna:
• 1838, Matthias Schleiden (German botanist) ne kaha ke tamam paude cells se bane hain; agle saal Theodor Schwann (German zoologist) ne yahi janwaron ke liye kaha.
• Rudolf Virchow (German physician) ne dekha ke tamam cells doosre cells se aate hain (1855; kitaab ka 1885 ghalat hai).
• 1862, Louis Pasteur ne is ka tajurbati saboot diya.
Cell theory: (1) tamam jandaar aik ya zyada cells se bane hain; (2) cells structure aur function ki bunyadi units hain; (3) cells sirf pehle se maujood cells ki taqseem se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: At the beginning of 17th century, many scientists began the use of microscopes

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitaab mein Virchow ka saal 1885 chhapa hai, magar Pasteur ka saboot 1862 ka hai, is liye 1885 mumkin nahi. Sahi saal 1855 hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 Answer the following about microscopes. (i) Define magnification and resolution of a microscope. (ii) Describe how a light microscope forms an image, and give its magnification, resolving power and limitations. (4 marks)
(Microscopes ke baare mein jawab dein. (i) Microscope ki magnification aur resolution ki definition likhein. (ii) Light microscope image kaise banata hai, aur is ki magnification, resolving power aur hadood batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Magnification microscope ki image bari karne ki salahiyat hai, nishan X (10X lens 1 µm cheez ko 10 µm dikhata hai); total magnification = tamam lenses ki magnification ka hasil-e-zarb. Resolution qareeb do points ko alag pehchanne ki salahiyat hai; resolution jitni zyada, tafseel utni bareek.

(ii) Light microscope mein light object se aur phir do sheeshe ke lenses se guzarti hai: aik lens image bari karta hai aur doosra mazeed bari karta hai, aur dekhne wale ki aankh mein bari saaf image banti hai.
• Magnification: 1500X (taqreeban 1500 guna).
• Resolving power: 0.2 µm (1 µm = 1/1000 mm); is se chhoti cheezein alag nahi dikhtin.
• Hadood: zinda jandaar dekhe ja sakte hain, magar cells shaffaf hote hain, is liye un ke hisse stains (rangeen chemicals) ke baghair nazar nahi aate, aur staining aksar cells ko maar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: One lens produces an enlarged image of the object and the second lens magnifies the image more

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the electron microscope and its two types used by biologists. (4 marks)
(Electron microscope aur biologists ke istemal wali is ki do qismon ko bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Electron microscope: electrons ki beam object se guzarti hai aur magnetic lenses use screen ya photographic film par focus kar ke bohat bari image banate hain. Is ki resolving power light microscope se kahin zyada hai: yeh 0.2 nm (1 nm = 1/1000,000 mm) jitni chhoti cheez saaf dikha sakta hai. Specimen tayyar karne ke tareeqon ki wajah se is se zinda maadda nahi dekha ja sakta.

1. Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM): cell ki andar ki structure dekhne ke liye. Yeh electrons ki beam bohat patle specimen se guzarta hai aur 250,000 guna tak bara karta hai.

2. Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM): cells ya doosri cheezon ki satah ki tafseel ke liye. Satah par dhaat chadhai jaati hai; beam dhaat se reflect ho kar bari image banati hai. SEM 100,000 guna tak bara karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Biologists use two types of electron microscopes

blocks.prompt:
5 Answer the following about the plant cell wall. (i) What are plasmodesmata? How are they formed and why are they important? (ii) Describe the functions of the cell wall. (4 marks)
(Plant cell wall ke baare mein jawab dein. (i) Plasmodesmata kya hain? Yeh kaise bante hain aur kyun ahem hain? (ii) Cell wall ke kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Plasmodesmata (wahid plasmodesma) chhoti naliyan hain jo saath wale plant cells ke cytoplasm ko seedha jorti hain. Yeh primary aur secondary dono walls ke aar paar jaati hain. Yeh cell division ke dauran bante hain jab parent cell ke endoplasmic reticulum ke hisse nayi cell wall mein phans jaate hain. In se kuch molecules seedha aik cell se doosre mein jaate hain, is liye yeh cells ke baahami raabte (communication) ke liye ahem hain.

(ii) Cell wall ke kaam:
• Cell ko sakhti de kar structural aur mechanical sahara deti hai.
• Cell ki shakal aur growth ki simt, aur aakhir mein paude ki banawat qaim rakhti hai.
• Paani andar aane par cell ko phoolne se rokti hai.
• Pathogens (jaraseem) aur mahol se hifazat karti hai.
• Paude ke liye carbohydrates ka zakheera hai.

book_ref.quote: Plasmodesmata penetrate both the primary and secondary cell walls

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the fluid mosaic model of the plasma membrane, explaining the arrangement of phospholipids, cholesterol and proteins in it. (4 marks)
(Plasma membrane ke fluid mosaic model ko bayan karein aur is mein phospholipids, cholesterol aur proteins ki tarteeb samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Fluid mosaic model, jo S.J. Singer aur Garth Nicolson ne 1972 mein pesh kiya, plasma membrane ki badalti (dynamic) fitrat bayan karta hai.

Phospholipid bilayer: bunyad phospholipids ki lipid bilayer hai. Har phospholipid ke aik sire par phosphate group hai; phosphate wala sira hydrophilic (paani pasand) aur C-H zanjeeron wali dum hydrophobic (paani se door) hai. Bilayer mein hydrophobic dumein andar aur hydrophilic phosphate groups bahar, cytoplasm ya bairooni mahol ki taraf hote hain. Hydrophobic andar paani mein hal hone wale molecules ko rokta hai.

Cholesterol: eukaryotes mein cholesterol molecules bilayer ke beech phanse hote hain aur kam temperature par membrane ko fluid rakhte hain.

Proteins: bohat se proteins lipid bilayer mein tairte hain aur kuch sirf satah se chipke hote hain; in ki jagah cytoskeleton se mutaliq hai. Yeh channels aur transporters, cytoskeleton se jorne wale, receptors aur enzymes ka kaam karte hain. Bahar ki satah ke proteins aur lipids se sugar zanjeerein juri hain (glycoproteins, glycolipids yani glycocalyx) jo pehchaan ke nishan hain.

book_ref.quote: According to the fluid mosaic model, the basic foundation of plasma membrane is a lipid bilayer

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the techniques used to study the structure of the plasma membrane. (4 marks)
(Plasma membrane ki structure ke mutaale ki techniques bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
• Transmission Electron Microscopy: lipid bilayer aur proteins ki tafseeli structure dikhati hai.
• Scanning Electron Microscopy: cells aur membranes ki satah ki banawat dikhati hai.
• Confocal Microscopy: laser scanning aur fluorescence se membrane ki saaf, tafseeli tasveerein banati hai.
• Total Internal Reflection Fluorescence Microscopy: membrane aur cytoskeleton se is ke raabte ki unchi resolution wali tasveerein deti hai.
• Atomic Force Microscopy: membrane ki satah ki unchi resolution wali tasveerein deti hai.
• X-ray Crystallography: membrane proteins ki atomic structure maloom karti hai.
• Lipidomics: mass spectrometry jaisi techniques se membrane ke lipids ka mukammal tajziya.
• Fluorescence Recovery After Photobleaching: fluorescent hisse ko laser se bleach kar ke aur bleach na hue molecules ki aamad se fluorescence ki wapsi dekh kar proteins aur lipids ki harkat ka mutaala.

book_ref.quote: Total Internal Reflection Fluorescence Microscopy is used for high-resolution images of the membrane

blocks.prompt:
8 The nucleolus makes ribosomes. (i) Describe the structure of the nucleolus and its formation. (ii) Explain how eukaryotic ribosomes are produced in the nucleolus and used for protein synthesis. (4 marks)
(Nucleolus ribosomes banata hai. (i) Nucleolus ki structure aur banne ka tareeqa bayan karein. (ii) Wazahat karein ke eukaryotic ribosomes nucleolus mein kaise bante hain aur protein synthesis mein kaise istemal hote hain.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Nucleolus nucleoplasm mein numayan, gehra rangeen dhaancha hai; aik nucleus mein aik ya do ho sakte hain. Yeh chromosomes ki khaas jagahon Nucleolus Organizer Regions (NORs) par banta hai jin ka DNA rRNA ka code rakhta hai. Is mein granular aur fibrillar hisse aur DNA hai: granules pehle se bane ribosomal subunits hain; fibrils kacha maal yani rRNA aur proteins hain. Zyada protein banane wale cells mein nucleolus bara hota hai; mitosis ke shuru mein yeh ghayab ho jata hai aur baad mein NORs se naya banta hai.

(ii) Ribosomal proteins nucleolus mein aa kar rRNA se mil kar do subunits banate hain, chhota (40S) aur bara (60S). Subunits nuclear pores se nucleus se nikalte hain. Cytoplasm mein dono mil kar (80S ribosome) protein banate hain: mRNA DNA se li hui hidayat deta hai aur tRNA amino acids laata hai; mukammal zanjeer chhor di jaati hai. Jab protein nahi ban raha hota to dono subunits alag ho jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: Eukaryote ribosomes are produced and assembled in the nucleolus

blocks.prompt:
9 Mitochondria and chloroplasts are thought to have come from prokaryotes. Explain the evidence given in the chapter and the hypothesis about the origin of mitochondria. (4 marks)
(Khayal hai ke mitochondria aur chloroplasts prokaryotes se aaye. Chapter mein diye gaye saboot aur mitochondria ki ibtida ka hypothesis samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Saboot:
• Mitochondrion ka apna gol (circular) DNA hai jo prokaryotes ke DNA jaisa hai, har qisam ka RNA aur 70S ribosomes hain (prokaryotes wali qisam).
• Mitochondria aur chloroplasts ke andar ke ribosomes cytoplasm ke ribosomes se size aur banawat mein mukhtalif aur prokaryotes jaise hain.
• Dono ka apna DNA hai aur dono cell aur us ke nucleus se azad ho kar barhte aur nasal barhate hain.
Yeh baatein cell theory ki exception hain aur ishara karti hain ke yeh organelles shayad azad prokaryotic cells se bane.

Mitochondria ka hypothesis: lakhon saal pehle chhote azad prokaryotes ko bare prokaryotes ne nigal liya magar hazm nahi kiya. Waqt ke saath dono mein symbiotic (bahami faide ka) rishta bana: bare ne chhote ko bharpoor ghiza di aur chhote ne bare ko ATP molecules diye.

book_ref.quote: Like mitochondria, chloroplasts also contain their own DNA and are able to grow and reproduce independently

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the structure of a chloroplast and explain how it carries out photosynthesis. (4 marks)
(Chloroplast ki structure bayan karein aur samjhayein ke yeh photosynthesis kaise karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Photosynthesis, yani light energy ko chemical energy mein badal kar khana banana, chloroplasts mein hota hai. Paude ke tamam hare hisson mein chloroplasts hain magar zyada photosynthesis patton mein hoti hai (patte ki satah par taqreeban aadha million chloroplasts fi square millimetre).

Structure:
• Ghilaaf: bayzawi (ellipsoid) chloroplast do membranes mein band hai, darmiyan intermembrane space; bahar wali membrane andar wali se kahin zyada permeable hai.
• Stroma: andar wali membrane ke andar neem maaye maadda jis mein enzymes ghule hain; yeh zyada hajam hai.
• Thylakoids: andar ki membranes kinaron se jur kar disk jaise khaane banati hain; thylakoids ke dher grana hain (aik chloroplast mein sau ya zyada grana).
• Lamellae: baghair hare rang ke hisse jo do grana ko jorte hain.
• Chlorophyll a aur chlorophyll b light jazb karte hain; chloroplast ka apna DNA hai aur yeh khud nasal barhata hai.

Kaam: thylakoid disks ka chlorophyll light jazb kar ke electrons chhorta hai aur ATP bante hain. Inhi ATPs se stroma mein kam energy wali carbon dioxide glucose jaisi zyada energy wali cheez mein badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: The ellipsoid-shaped chloroplast is enclosed by two membranes

blocks.prompt:
11 Lysosomes are digestive compartments of the cell. (i) What are lysosomal storage diseases? Describe two examples. (ii) Explain the role of lysosomes in selective cell death. (4 marks)
(Lysosomes cell ke hazme ke khaane hain. (i) Lysosomal storage diseases kya hain? Do misalein bayan karein. (ii) Chuni hui cell death mein lysosomes ka kirdaar samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Lysosomal storage diseases mein mareez ke lysosome ka koi hydrolytic enzyme nahi hota. Ghair mamooli lysosome na hazm hone wali cheezon se bhar jata hai jo cell ke kaam mein rukawat dalti hain.
• Pompe's disease: lysosome mein glycogen hazm karne wala enzyme nahi hota, is liye liver cells mein nuqsan deh had tak glycogen jama hota hai.
• Tay-Sachs disease: lipid hazm karne wala zaroori enzyme nahi hota. Dimagh ke nerve cells mein lipids jama ho kar nervous system ko nuqsan, zehni pasmandgi aur bachpan mein maut ka sabab bante hain.

(ii) Lysosomes poore cells ko bhi khatam karte hain. Chuni hui cell death multicellular jandaaron ki development ka aik tareeqa hai. Maslan tadpole ke maindak banne par dum ke cells lysosome ke enzymes se khatam hote hain. Development mein dimagh ke kayi cells bhi marte hain; yeh khud-kushi un cells ke lysosomes phatne se hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The abnormal lysosome fills with indigestible substances, which interfere with cellular functions

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe peroxisomes: their enzymes, functions and the disorder caused by their defects. How are glyoxysomes related to them? (4 marks)
(Peroxisomes bayan karein: in ke enzymes, kaam aur in ki kharabi se hone wali bimari. Glyoxysomes ka in se kya talluq hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Peroxisomes aik membrane wale organelles hain jo tamam eukaryotic cells mein hain; inhein Christian de Duve ne daryaft kiya jis ne lysosomes bhi daryaft kiye.

Enzymes aur kaam:
• Kayi enzymes oxidative hain jo oxidation (electrons aur hydrogens hatana) karte hain; in ka bara kaam cell se zehreele maadde khatam karna hai.
• Liver cells ke peroxisomes alcohol aur doosre nuqsan deh compounds ko oxidation se be-zarar karte hain.
• Kuch mein catalase hai jo hydrogen peroxide (metabolism ki aam zimni paidawar) ko paani aur oxygen mein torta hai: 2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂.

Bimari: kharabi se metabolic bimariyan hoti hain; sab se sangeen Zellweger syndrome hai jis mein peroxisomes nahi ya kam hote hain. Yeh paidaishi hai, is ka ilaaj nahi aur aksar pehle saal mein maut ho jaati hai.

Glyoxysomes peroxisomes jaise hain magar sirf plant cells mein. In ke enzymes lipids ko carbohydrates banate hain; yeh chikanai wale beejon (castor beans, soyabeans) mein zyada hain aur germination mein jama lipids ko carbohydrates bana kar energy dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Many of these enzymes are oxidative that carry out oxidation

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the structure of the central vacuole of a plant cell and explain its roles in the plant. (4 marks)
(Plant cell ke central vacuole ki structure bayan karein aur paude mein is ke kaam samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Structure: vacuoles maaye se bhare, aik membrane wale thaile hain. Cells mein kayi chhote vacuoles hote hain; plant cell ke pukhta hone par yeh mil kar aik bara central vacuole banate hain jo cell ki 80 percent ya zyada jagah leta hai. Ise tonoplast membrane gherti hai aur andar ka maadda cell sap ird gird ke cytoplasm se kaafi mukhtalif hai. (Janwaron ke cells ke vacuoles bohat chhote hain aur zyada tar cheezein waqti tor par jama ya muntaqil karte hain.)

Kaam:
• Sahara: kaafi paani milne par vacuoles phool kar zyada turgor pressure banate hain; is se cell sakht hota hai aur cell wall ke saath paude ka dhaancha qaim rehta hai.
• Zakheera, fuzla thikane lagana, hifazat aur growth; kuch jama cheezein insaanon ke liye mufeed hain (opium, rubber, lehsan ka zaiqa).
• Vacuoles ke pigments phoolon ko rang de kar shehad ki makhiyon aur pollinators ko khenchte hain.
• Vacuoles keeron aur janwaron ke liye zehreele molecules chhorte hain taa ke woh paude ko na khayen.

book_ref.quote: The central vacuole in plant cells plays an important structural role for the plant

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the structure of eukaryotic cilia and flagella, including the axoneme and the basal body. How do prokaryotic flagella differ? (4 marks)
(Eukaryotic cilia aur flagella ki structure, axoneme aur basal body samait, bayan karein. Prokaryotic flagella kaise mukhtalif hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Cilia aur flagella kuch cells se nikle patle, dum jaise harkat ke aazaa hain. Cilia chhote aur aam tor par zyada hote hain; flagella lambe aur kam. (Insaanon mein trachea ki tah ke cilia balgham aur mitti ko saans ki naliyon se bahar dhakelte hain.)

Axoneme: eukaryotic cilium ya flagellum ka markaz. Is mein do darmiyani microtubules hain jin ke gird nau doublet microtubules ka ring hai ("9 + 2" structure). Is ke gird dynein molecules saath wale doublets ko jorte hain. Poore axoneme ke gird plasma membrane hai.

Basal body: cilium ki jar mein organising markaz. Is ki banawat axoneme ke bahar wale ring jaisi hai magar nau sets mein har aik mein doublet ki jagah teen microtubules (triplets) hain. Basal body asal mein centriole hai (centriole nau microtubule triplets ka khokhla cylinder hai).

Prokaryotic flagella bilkul mukhtalif hain: membrane se ghire nahi, protein flagellin ki dohrai units se bane hain aur un mein microtubule triplets nahi hote.

book_ref.quote: At the base of the cilium its organising centre, called basal body, is present

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the structure of a generalized prokaryotic cell. (4 marks)
(Aam prokaryotic cell ki structure bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bacteria aur archaea prokaryotic cells se bane hain jo eukaryotic cells se kahin saada hain.
• Size: zyada tar 2 se 8 µm lambe, yani aam eukaryotic cell ka das wan hissa.
• Nucleoid: nucleus nahi; kam DNA aik darmiyani hisse nucleoid mein hota hai.
• Cytoplasm: aik hi unit, andar koi sahara dene wala dhaancha nahi; membrane wale organelles (ER, mitochondria, chloroplasts, Golgi, lysosomes, peroxisomes) nahi hote.
• Ribosomes: hote hain magar chhote, 70S (30S aur 50S subunits), sab cytoplasm mein azad.
• Plasma membrane ke gird peptidoglycan (amino acids aur sugar ka aik bara polymer) ki cell wall, cellulose nahi.
• Bacteria mein wall ke gird capsule aur chipakne wale hisse pili (wahid pilus) ho sakte hain.
• Flagella protein flagellin ki dohrai units se bane, microtubule triplets nahi.
• Taqseem: mitosis ya meiosis nahi; cell seedhi taqseem (binary fission) se batta hai.

book_ref.quote: Prokaryotic cells are much simpler than eukaryotic ones

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitaab mein pili ka wahid "pillus" chhapa hai; sahi spelling pilus hai.

blocks.prompt:
16 Define cell signalling. Describe its three steps. (4 marks)
(Cell signalling ki definition likhein aur is ke teen qadam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cell signalling cells ki mahol ke stimuli ka jawab dene ki salahiyat hai; is mein molecular waqiyat ke silsile se cells ke darmiyan signal jaate hain.

1. Signal reception: signalling tab shuru hoti hai jab signal molecule (ligand) target cell ke receptor se jurta hai. Receptors aam tor par membrane mein jure proteins hain magar cell ke andar bhi ho sakte hain. Har receptor kisi khaas ligand ke liye hai.

2. Signal transduction: ligand se jurne par receptor ki shakal badalti hai (conformational change) aur cell ke andar signalling ka raasta chalu hota hai. Interactions ka silsila signalling cascade banata hai jo signal ko barhata hai. cAMP, calcium ions aur inositol triphosphate (IP₃) jaise chhote molecules second messengers ban kar signal ko receptor se andar ke targets tak le jaate hain.

3. Cellular response: raasta aksar gene expression badalta hai, genes on ya off hote hain. Nateeja: cell growth, division, differentiation ya apoptosis (programmed cell death), aur metabolism, enzyme activity ya ion channels ke khulne band hone mein tabdeeli.

book_ref.quote: Once the receptor binds to the ligand, it undergoes a conformational change

blocks.prompt:
17 What is facilitated diffusion? Describe the two main types of transport proteins involved in it, with examples. (4 marks)
(Facilitated diffusion kya hai? Is mein shamil transport proteins ki do bari qismein misalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Facilitated diffusion: kuch molecules plasma membrane ke transport proteins ki madad se cell mein aate ya jaate hain. Jab transport protein kisi maadde ko us ke concentration gradient ke saath (zyada se kam) le jaye to yeh facilitated diffusion hai. Energy nahi lagti, is liye yeh passive transport hai. Is ki raftaar membrane mein maujood transport proteins ki tadaad par munhasir hai.

1. Channel proteins: membrane mein hydrophilic naliyan banate hain jin se khaas molecules ya ions guzarte hain. Yeh gated ya non-gated hote hain; gated channels voltage ki tabdeeli, ligand ke jurne ya mechanical dabao par khulte ya band hote hain. Misalein: ion channels (Na⁺, K⁺, Ca²⁺, Cl⁻ ke liye) aur aquaporins (paani ki tez naqal).

2. Carrier proteins (transporters): apne khaas molecule se jurte hain, shakal badalte hain aur use membrane ke paar le jaate hain. Yeh bohat makhsoos hain aur saturate ho sakte hain, yani sab masroof hon to raftaar apni hadd par pohanch jaati hai. Misalein: glucose transporters aur amino acid transporters.

book_ref.quote: When a transport protein helps a substance to move it down its concentration gradient

blocks.prompt:
18 Water moves across membranes by osmosis. (i) Define osmosis and explain the terms hypertonic, hypotonic and isotonic. (ii) What is reverse osmosis and how does it differ from natural osmosis? (4 marks)
(Paani membranes ke aar paar osmosis se guzarta hai. (i) Osmosis ki definition likhein aur hypertonic, hypotonic aur isotonic ki wazahat karein. (ii) Reverse osmosis kya hai aur yeh qudrati osmosis se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Osmosis paani ke molecules ka cell membrane ke aar paar zyada (paani ki) concentration se kam ki taraf diffusion hai. Energy nahi lagti, is liye yeh paani ka passive transport hai. Yeh selectively permeable membrane se hota hai jo paani ko guzarne deti aur kayi solutes ko rokti hai. Simt dono taraf ke solute concentration par munhasir hai: paani hamesha hypotonic se hypertonic mahlool ki taraf jata hai. Osmosis paudon mein turgor aur cells mein paani ka tawazun qaim rakhta hai; aquaporins paani ki naqal tez karte hain.
Tonicity solutes ka nisbati concentration hai: hypertonic mein solute zyada, hypotonic mein kam, aur isotonic mein barabar.

(ii) Reverse osmosis paani saaf karne ki technology hai. Qudrati osmosis mein paani kam solute se zyada solute ki taraf jata hai; reverse osmosis mein bairooni dabao se paani semi-permeable membrane ke zariye zyada solute se kam solute ki taraf dhakela jata hai. Is se ghule namak aur gandagi nikal jaati hai aur peene ka saaf paani milta hai; yeh water treatment plants, desalination aur gharelu filters mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Osmosis occurs through selectively permeable membrane, which allows water to pass while restricting many solutes

blocks.prompt:
19 Define active transport. Describe active transport through carrier proteins, endocytosis and exocytosis. (4 marks)
(Active transport ki definition likhein. Carrier proteins ke zariye active transport, endocytosis aur exocytosis bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Active transport plasma membrane ke aar paar maaddon ki kam concentration se zyada concentration ki taraf energy laga kar harkat hai.

1. Carrier proteins se: carrier proteins energy laga kar molecules ko gradient ke khilaf le jaate hain. Misaal: nerve cells ka sodium-potassium pump. Aaram ki halat mein yeh ATP laga kar Na⁺ ko bahar aur K⁺ ko andar le jata hai taa ke andar K⁺ zyada aur Na⁺ kam rahe.

2. Endocytosis: bhaari maadde cell ke andar laaye jaate hain. Plasma membrane ka hissa andar dhansta hai, bahar ka maadda us mein aata hai, kinare band ho kar chhota vesicle banta hai jo alag ho kar cytoplasm mein chala jata hai. Qismein: phagocytosis (thos maadda) aur pinocytosis (maaye qatron ki shakal mein). Receptor-mediated endocytosis mein khaas receptor proteins maadda pakarte hain, maslan liver cells khoon se LDLs (cholesterol wale) lete hain.

3. Exocytosis: bhaari maadda bahar bheja jata hai. Ise membrane mein band kar ke vesicle banta hai jo plasma membrane tak ja kar us se jurta hai aur maadda bahar chhor deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
20 Stem cells have great medical potential. (i) Describe the uses of stem cells in medicine and research. (ii) Why do adult stem cells involve less ethical controversy than embryonic stem cells, and what are their drawbacks? (4 marks)
(Stem cells mein ilaaj ki bari salahiyat hai. (i) Medicine aur research mein stem cells ke istemal bayan karein. (ii) Adult stem cells mein embryonic stem cells se kam akhlaqi tanaza kyun hai, aur in ki khamiyan kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Stem cells ke istemal:
• Regenerative medicine: stem cells kharab tissues aur organs ki marammat ya tabdeeli kar sakte hain, is liye spinal cord injury, type 1 diabetes, Parkinson's disease aur dil ki bimari mein istemal hote hain.
• Dawaon ki testing: stem cells ko khaas cell types mein badal kar insani bimariyon ke models banaye jaate hain jin se dawaon ki behtar testing hoti hai aur janwaron par inhisaar kam hota hai.
• Personalized medicine: stem cells mareez ke apne cells se ban sakte hain, is liye immune rejection ka khatra kam aur ilaaj zyada mufeed aur mehfooz hota hai.

(ii) Embryonic stem cells blastocyst ke andar wale cell mass se aate hain, is liye insani embryos ke istemal par akhlaqi aitraaz hai, saath teratoma aur immune rejection ka khatra bhi. Adult stem cells bone marrow, charbi aur khoon jaise tissues mein hain, is liye embryo istemal nahi hota; mareez ke apne tissue se lene par rejection ka khatra bhi kam hai. Khamiyan: yeh multipotent hain, in ki differentiation salahiyat mehdood hai (sirf apne tissue se mutaliq cell types), aur inhein alag karna aur culture karna mushkil hai.

book_ref.quote: Stem cells have the potential to repair or replace damaged tissues and organs
